evidence/body.name: interior-gronwall-to-endpoint-by-one-sided-limit
evidence/body.hook: interior Gronwall estimate on [δ,t]; recover endpoint by Tendsto along 𝓝[>] 0 and le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto
evidence/body.body: To compare two ODE solutions on a closed half-line when the available Gronwall-type distance bound (e.g. dist_le_of_trajectories_ODE with constant K from a proven Lipschitz lemma) is stated on a closed interval [δ,t] strictly inside the half-line: apply the bound on [δ,t] for arbitrary 0<δ<t, then send δ→0⁺ along the one-sided filter 𝓝[>] 0 using le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto; continuity of both solutions at the endpoint makes the distance bound continuous, so the limit inherits the inequality at δ=0. This turns an interior-only estimate into an endpoint-inclusive one without any extension theorem. Leaf (membership of 𝓝[>] 0): do NOT rewrite with nhdsWithin_eq (it unfolds 𝓝 itself into an infimum and the goal dies); instead prove Ioo 0 t ∈ 𝓝[>] 0 via inter_mem (mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds h)) (self_mem_nhdsWithin (s := Ioi 0)) plus an explicit set equality Iio t ∩ Ioi 0 = Ioo 0 t.
